title: Way to Get spam and fake sites off
creator: OkieUnix
content:
Let me explain there is some one with the following email:

noreply@redcarpetradar.robly.com

Whatever anyone does do NOT click on their links I believe it's a criminal organization trying to get to my account.

I know many of you may not be in my situation but I'm a bit job hungry cause financial hit really hard. I clicked on link without looking and the site pretended I needed to fill a job application out. So I did without looking to see who sent it. Yes, STUPID me.

For some reason I marked as junk and it's not going to where I need to and that is trash and immediately delete it. I try and see if I can setup a rule for that. But wondering if there a extension that might do a better job. I tried to unsubscribe but these guys keep hitting back. That one sign of hackers trying to penetrate.

So now I'm wondering is there anything else I might be over looking. One think I keep thinking about is why NOT put something a tool that will do similar to mxtoolbox. With AI out there it's going to get harder to keep these criminals out of our inboxes.

I appreciate any feedback.

title: Funzionamento QRcode per condigurazione Tablet da PC (Trasferimento account)
creator: marcenaro.ing.luca
content: Buongiorno, ho acquistato un tablet Lenovo e installato Thunderbird. Vorrei utilizzare la funzione QRCode per trasferire i vari account di posta dal mio PC al tablet. La fotocamera del tablet funziona bene e riconosce il QRCode ma se utilizzo la procedura avviando la fotocamera dall'applicazione Thunderbird per Tablet, la fotocamera non riconosce e non rileva il QRCode. Come posso fare? Grazie
